verdict.line: You lose if you let K'Sante stack Ntofo Strikes freely into level 6 all-in; you win if you out-trade his cooldown windows and close with Maiden pressure.

brief.thesis: This is a cooldown-trading lane: K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) builds stacks on-hit and fires a pulling shockwave at 2 stacks, and his W (Path Maker) has a charge-up that telegraphs his engage, so every trade is decided by whether he has those tools up. Yorick's W (Dark Procession) wall and E (Mourning Mist) armor shred give you the tools to punish him in the windows between those cooldowns. The 55% head-to-head win rate over 818 games says this favors you once you respect his all-in windows rather than walk into them.

theirWindow.when: Q at 2 stacks or W charging
theirWindow.what: He can pull you in with the Q shockwave or stun you off a W charge-dash. Do not stand in a line in front of him at 1-2 Q stacks, and back off the moment you see the W charge animation start.

yourWindow.when: his Q and W both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your trade window. Land Q (Last Rites) for the bonus damage and self-heal, then follow with E (Mourning Mist) to shred his armor and slow him before he can reset his tools.

powerCurve.note: poke trades, respect his Q slow
Maiden and Black Cleaver swing trades

start.why: The sustained-damage shield absorbs his poke from Q (Ntofo Strikes) and the autos he gets off his passive marks, keeping you above the threshold where his level 4-5 all-in kills.

boots.why: His kit is entirely physical autos and ability damage stacked on his passive marks; the flat reduction on his attack-speed-driven trades matters more than the slow resist from Swiftness here.

core.why: The on-hit proc and movement speed let you stick empowered Q (Last Rites) procs on him through his Footwork dashes.
Armor shred stacks on top of your E (Mourning Mist) reduction, letting your Maiden autos chew through his base-heavy kit.
Ability haste shortens your Q and E cooldowns, closing the gap between your trade windows so you get more reps in before his cooldowns reset.

situational.when: he is building toward a level 6 all-in burst pattern and you need a damage buffer
you are ahead and want a faster burst spike to close out skirmishes before his shields from E (Footwork) come up again
the lane stabilizes even and you want to leverage your wall and Maiden for a splitpush win condition

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp sustain outlasts his poke pattern from Q stacks and rewards you for holding the wave rather than forcing all-ins into his cooldowns.

summoners.why: Teleport is run in 63.6% of games here and posts the highest win rate (53.9%) because it lets you reset after trading sustain for tempo, and lets you answer his level 6 All Out roam threat without giving up wave state.

playing.title: Track his Q stack count
playing.detail: At 2 stacks his Ntofo Strikes fires a pulling shockwave. Never stand in melee range when he's at 1 stack unless you're ready to eat the pull.

playing.title: Punish the W charge animation
playing.detail: Path Maker requires a charge-up before the dash; he takes reduced damage during it but it telegraphs the stun. Step out of the dash line the instant you see it start.

playing.title: Wall off his Footwork escape
playing.detail: Drop W (Dark Procession) to block his E (Footwork) dash path when you commit to a kill, since Footwork's range extension only helps him if the path is open.

playing.title: Dig graves and let the Maiden snowball
playing.detail: Every Q (Last Rites) kill or championhit digs a grave; once R (Eulogy of the Isles) is up, the Maiden auto-raises Walkers from his death, so force short trades near graves rather than long ones.

playing.title: Hold E for his all-in, not for poke
playing.detail: Mourning Mist's armor shred and slow matter most inside his level 6-8 All Out window — don't dump it on a stray poke when you'll need the slow to disengage from his R knockback-and-chase.

playing.title: Respect levels 4-6 as his spike, not yours
playing.detail: His W stun and R All Out both come online in this window before your Trinity Force or Maiden are online. Play for trades, not kills, until level 9+.

playing.title: Teleport back in for his roam timers
playing.detail: All Out's 120/100/80s cooldown means his power windows repeat; use Teleport to punish side lanes the moment you see his R go on cooldown elsewhere.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample-size numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the cooldown windows, trade sequencing, and tactical reasoning are my own analysis layered on top of that data.
